name: arena-x-android
description: Capacitor Android packaging for the ARENA X static web application

scripts.android:sync: npm run android:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleDebug
scripts.android:release:apk: node scripts/build-android-web.mjs --release && cap sync android && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleRelease
scripts.android:release:aab: node scripts/build-android-web.mjs --release && cap sync android && android\gradlew.bat -p android bundleRelease
